description: Finds construction material on land near any Texas point: red select (red sandy clay select fill), sand, gravel, ironstone (iron ore gravel road material), caliche, limestone near the surface and roadfill, and every known pit, active and old. Returns: the soil and surface geology at the point with its material rating; pits within the radius (TCEQ-registered aggregate operations with operator, material and registration; USGS past producers; OpenStreetMap quarries; bare ground from 2001 and 2021 land cover that marks old or unregistered pits); market prices (TxDOT bid medians for the district: embankment fill and flexible base; landowner royalty and at-pit price references, each with its source); and ranked parcels of 10+ acres that carry the material, by default untapped ones with no pit yet, with material acres, red select depth, thickness, soil class and plasticity, caliche and limestone depth, appraised land $/acre, distance from the point, the nearest pit of the same material, and a dirt value range: landowner royalty and operator sales at the pit for the in-place red select volume, or per acre-foot where the soil survey gives no thickness. Use for 'where can I find red select near Tyler', 'caliche pit land near Midland', 'borrow pit for my pad', 'old gravel pits near here', 'what is the dirt on this tract worth'. Soil survey ratings cover the top 1.5 to 2 m and map soil associations, not every acre: confirm with test pits, lab gradation and plasticity, and a TCEQ APO registration before mining. Enterprise; free and Pro get counts.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

material.description: Material to rank parcels by. Default any (each parcel's best material).

min_material_acres.description: Least acres of the material on the parcel. Default 5.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles. Default 15, max 40.

royalty_usd_per_ton.description: Optional landowner royalty in $/ton the user supplies; replaces the cited royalty range in the dirt value.

status.description: untapped (default): parcels with the material and no known pit or bare ground; pit: parcels that already have one; all.

name: aggregate_screen
title: Dirt, sand, gravel, caliche and rock near a site
